horizontal.escena:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE independent full-bleed narrative or symbolic PHYSICAL PAPER-CUT artwork, never a three-panel collage. All reference images are OUR OWN AI-generated visual-bible sheets. Use their identities, shapes and material language, not their multiple-view layouts, cropped auxiliary portraits or white specimen insets. Very expressive handcrafted thick matte dyed cardstock: clear pale cut cross-sections, lifted and curled edges, separated shadows between actual layers, deliberate hand-cut curves, folded leaf midribs, cut and folded feather vanes, visibly woven paper fibres, water as overlapping blue sheets and ripples. Heads and faces use few QUIET paper planes with natural proportions; no polygon-faceted CGI cheekbones, shiny skin, plastic dolls or digital-paint substitutes. Whole principal bodies, feet, wings, snouts, tails and ornament tips remain inside frame. The environmental world continues outside all four edges; no visible plinth, frame, diorama perimeter, tabletop, collage, model-sheet layout or printed text. Material depth comes between world layers. Colors differentiate each actor and each narrative rather than cloning the same hunter. Preserve proper reference clothes: bark/fibre covers and sparse seeds, feathers and small quill ornaments where present, no modern shirts, trousers, ponchos or synthetic beads. When a character has a pale nasal quill in the reference, make its near tip plainly visible at the nostril base against skin. No real-person likeness, private-photo reuse, medical or ritual instructions. This is original editorial art of the frozen adaptation, not a certified traditional motif.

MYTH: El diluvio y el origen de los bailes. FORMAT: horizontal 16:9, preferably 1536 x 864. FUNCTION: ENTRADA: expansive environmental situation opening the myth; figures small within the world, not a giant portrait.
Reference 1: P14 — Buinaima. Buinaima: mature broad-faced elder, wide natural nose and lined mouth, grey-black shoulder hair. Modest short GREEN feather ring with FOUR golden-yellow upward feathers. Sparse alternating black-seed / cream pendant necklace, small pale quill nasal ornament. Cream knee-length raw fibre hip wrap with two dark FRONT zigzags and an ochre waist-paper edge. Separate white shoulder-paper strips and fine original charcoal cheek arcs, no white glowing skin or celestial mask.
Reference 2: H03-retorno — Humanidad · estado mojado y frío. 
Reference 3: L03 — Río · ribera baja y paso. 

PRIMARY SCENE / OPERATION:
Wide steam-veiled river world after the flood, rust-red dawn reflected in layered cobalt water. ONE whole Buinaima matching P14 stands on a small surviving strip of earth beside TWO whole fully clothed wet human adults selected from H03-retorno. They emerge from a low opening in the earth, cold and silent, feet on the ground. One extraordinary return: living people coming from beneath ruined soil. No Noah ark, Christian icon, modern disaster scene, bodies in boiling water or extra crowd census. Rooted drowned forest sheets and warm steam-paper bands create the scale, with hope expressed by a new green shoot near the opening.

VISIBLE CHECK: Buinaima y dos adultos enteros reaparecen junto a una abertura de tierra.

vertical.escena:
Use case: image editing. Edit OUR OWN AI-GENERATED paper-cut original, reference image 1. Make one independent full-bleed artwork in vertical 9:16, preferably 864 x 1536.

CORRECTION:
Pull the camera BACK about 30 percent. Recenter the group of exactly THREE adults so each whole head, hair, feather tips, shoulders, arms, hands, garment and both feet are fully inside the vertical canvas with clear margins on both sides. Keep the whole hummingbird touching the ember at the small fire, the recovering warmth and the flooded forest outside the palm-leaf house. Preserve all three original identities and clothes. No additional people.

Preserve expressive physical matte cardstock, actual separated layer shadows, pale cut cross-sections, hand-cut curves, folded feather vanes and leaf midribs. Quiet natural paper-plane faces, no CGI, plastic or digital painting. The environment continues beyond all four borders; no frame, plinth or specimen-sheet layout. No printed text. Every principal whole body, head, hand, foot, wing and ornament tip must remain inside the canvas. Retain the original color relationships and traditional fibre covers. These are original editorial illustrations, not certified traditional symbols. No private photo, real-person likeness or ritual instructions.
